$comment: The locale table, and the single source of truth for it.
It lives in JSON rather than in src/locales/index.ts because four consumers
need it and only one of them is inside the Vite graph: the app imports it and
types it as Record<Language, LocaleMeta>, while scripts/build-sitemap.mjs,
scripts/i18n-coverage.mjs and api/meta-proxy.ts read it directly. Each of
those used to carry its own copy of the list under a 'keep in step with
src/locales/index.ts' comment - a missed entry silently dropped a locale from
the sitemap or served crawlers the wrong <html lang>, neither of which is
